_comment: Image mapping v2 - uses content-aware positioning

_presets_v2.right_of_content: Places image to the RIGHT of content, vertically CENTERED
_presets_v2.right_of_content_top: Places image to the RIGHT of content, TOP-ALIGNED (recommended)
_presets_v2.below_content: Places image BELOW actual text content
_presets_v2.right_half_safe: Right half of slide, but avoids title area
_presets_v2.center_below_title: Centered on slide, but positioned below title
